detected_by: the gate-fail decomposition analysis over the committed v3 lane pool bytes (post-verdict diagnosis; the decomposition script is deterministic and committed)
severity: quarantined + repaired + pinned by tests (the R412 v2 gate-field-defect precedent: root cause from committed bytes, fix disclosed, original evidence preserved)
description: The retrieval fabric's canonicalization dropped every field that a metadata-only source uniquely carried. Three coupled mechanisms, all measured from the committed v3 pool bytes: (1) canonical.py read rec.publication_year only from normalized.publication_year or normalized.year — crossref persists the year as issued_year (212/483 union records lost their year) and the patent adapters as publication_date (176/483 lost their year); (2) best_record was only assigned when a source's normalized record had a LONGER abstract than the incumbent — metadata-only sources (crossref, google_patents) never won that comparison, so best_record stayed EMPTY for any record with no abstract-bearing appearance, and every field only those sources carried (issued_year, publication_date, snippet) was dropped for the whole canonical record; (3) the engine-item abstract fallback chain (abstract/claims_excerpt/summary) never read snippet — the patent adapters' ONLY text field — so 176 google_patents records entered the pools as zero-text records (no numeric evidence extractable from them at all).

measured_effect_on_gate_metrics.year_recovery_rate: 0.3313 measured vs 0.5 threshold — 388/483 records lost their year to causes (1)+(2); crossref and google_patents jointly are 80% of the pool
measured_effect_on_gate_metrics.abstract_bearing_rate: 0.4865 vs 0.6 — the 176 patent records contributed zero text (cause 3); crossref is metadata-only by provider design (disclosed limitation, not a defect)
measured_effect_on_gate_metrics.numeric_bearing_rate: 0.1491 vs 0.15 (fails by 0.0009) — numeric extraction runs over title+abstract; zero-text records cannot yield numeric evidence
measured_effect_on_gate_metrics.recall_metrics: NOT affected — recall is identity-based (DOI/title fingerprint), the identities were persisted correctly

verdict_influence: The gate FAIL stands. This incident DEFLATED four rate metrics (infrastructure-manufactured failure components, Art. LXI) but the recall failures are genuine (cause 1 in GATE_FAIL_DECOMPOSITION.json: the sealed lane query forms do not retrieve the reference records — europepmc/core papers that a comparison-targeted query form surfaces). The arm is stopped by the pre-registered rule either way; these repairs cannot and do not resurrect the verdict (stopping rule 2: a failed gate is never retried with revised thresholds). The repairs exist so the NEXT arm's instrument measures what it claims to measure.
counterfactual_honesty: What the repaired pipeline would have measured on this run's retrievals is NOT_MEASURABLE_FROM_COMMITTED_BYTES: the dropped fields were never persisted, so no counterfactual rate is asserted (Art. XXV). The repair effect will be measured on the next arm's fresh retrievals.
fix: canonical.py: rec.publication_year now reads publication_year, year, issued_year, publication_date (verbatim provider strings; a record with no year-bearing field still stays None — Art. XXV)

canonical.py: best_record is seeded by the record's FIRST appearance (a record's representative is never emptier than any of its appearances); a strictly-richer abstract still replaces it — the original richest-representative precedence is unchanged
pipeline.py: the engine-item abstract fallback chain now falls back to snippet (after abstract/claims_excerpt/summary) so patent snippets are no longer discarded
fix_pinned_by: tests/test_r412_v3_norm_fields.py (6 tests: crossref issued_year survives; patent date+snippet survive; full pool-record year chain; metadata-only seeds then richer wins; no year is ever fabricated; patent-snippet numeric evidence extractable). Battery: 97 legacy retrieval tests + 6 new = 103/103 green.
constitution_articles: XI (evidence preserved — the defective pools stay committed as the honest first attempt)
XXV (unknown stays unknown — no counterfactual rates)
XXVII (the repairs read fields, they never invent values)
LXI (infrastructure failure is never scientific rejection — the four deflated rate metrics are infrastructure-manufactured failure components)
LIX (thresholds untouched; queries untouched; the FAIL verdict is recorded, never retried)
XVII/XVI (the repairs are pinned by adversarial tests)
